copy.gary: I've been wandering Cookeville parks and I still find something new on most visits, like a paddleboat ride on the lake at Cane Creek Park or a quiet loop through City Lake Natural Area.
copy.description: Check in at every Cookeville, Tennessee park you visit, collect stamps and badges, rate your favorites and explore with your Park Pals.

motifs.name: The Depot
motifs.blurb: The 1909 Tennessee Central Railway depot downtown is now the Cookeville Depot Museum, with a caboose out front.

motifs.name: Cane Creek lake
motifs.blurb: Cane Creek Park wraps around a 56-acre lake with fishing piers, and paddleboats, kayaks and canoes to rent in season.

motifs.name: Waterfall country
motifs.blurb: The Upper Cumberland around Cookeville is waterfall country, with Burgess Falls and Cummins Falls a short drive away.

motifs.name: Disc golf
motifs.blurb: Cane Creek Park's 18-hole disc golf course is open to everyone, and you can rent discs at the concession stand.

motifs.name: Dogwood blossoms
motifs.blurb: Dogwood Park, in the middle of downtown, has a performance pavilion for summer concerts and festivals.

motifs.name: Golden Eagles
motifs.blurb: Cookeville is home to Tennessee Tech University and its Golden Eagles.
